content.text: No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalties, or minimum/early-termination fees exist in the agreement, so the preferred position is met.

input.quote: 12.3 Additional Termination Rights by AbbVie. AbbVie may terminate this Agreement in its entirety, or on a country or other jurisdiction -by-country or other jurisdiction basis, for any or no reason, upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to Harpoon.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or minimum-fee concept payable by AbbVie (our party), which meets the preferred position of no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties. Searches for "liquidated damages" and "penalty" return nothing, and Article 12 gives AbbVie an unqualified termination-for-convenience right on 90 days' notice (Section 12.3) with no termination fee or accelerated-payment obligation; the termination consequences in Sections 12.6–12.8 are reversion/transition mechanics rather than a stipulated damages payment, and Section 12.9 preserves ordinary remedies at law rather than fixing a liquidated sum. The only payment-related sanction is mutual interest on late payments under Section 6.10, which applies equally to both Parties and is ordinarily acceptable compensatory interest, not a penalty. Milestone and royalty payments in Article 6 are consideration for rights granted, not liquidated damages, and survive only for events occurring before termination (Section 12.10.1). No redline required.
